title: CorporateAction
description: A point-in-time corporate-action record consumed by pit-adjuster. Each event carries an ex-date and an adjustment factor; availability is recorded for auditability.

ex_date.description: Ex-date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only events with ex_date <= the rebuild's as-of date participate.

adjustment_factor.description: Adjustment factor for the event: (prior_close - cash) / (prior_close * (1 + bonus + transfer)). Must be finite and positive.

available_at.description: ISO timestamp when this event became knowable (audit trail; informational for the engine).

action_id.description: Stable event identifier for deduplication and provenance.
